dealSummary: Etched, an AI chip developer, is in talks to raise two rounds: one led by Sequoia at a $10 billion valuation, and one led by Jane Street at a $20 billion valuation, The Wall Street Journal reported.

dealSummary: Boston-based Neo, which helps enterprises secure and govern AI software, emerged from stealth with a $75 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners and a previously undisclosed $25 million seed round.
leadInvestors: Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, a previously undisclosed $25 million seed round

dealSummary: Empirical Security, a cybersecurity startup specializing in exposure management, raised a $25 million Series A led by Brightmind Partners.

San Francisco-based Infinity, which builds software that helps AI chips run models faster, raised $15 million in seed funding from investors including Touring Capital and Principal VC at a $100 million valuation.
